results.name: test_english_to_german_as_is_check
results.tested: Translating English sentence 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.' to German (dest='de')
results.expected: German translation distinct from English source text (e.g. 'Der schnelle braune Fuchs...')
results.returned: 'Der schnelle Braunfuchs springt über den faulen Hund.'
results.details: Test completed successfully.

results.name: test_batch_translation
results.tested: Batch translating list: ['Good morning', 'Thank you', 'Goodbye'] to Japanese (dest='ja')
results.expected: List of 3 Translated objects with dest='ja'
results.returned: List of 3 items: ['おはよう', 'ありがとう', 'さようなら']
results.details: Test completed successfully.

results.name: test_special_characters_and_formatting
results.tested: Translating formatted HTML text 'Hello world! Special symbols: @#$% & 1234.' to Spanish (dest='es')
results.expected: Translated text preserving HTML tags ..., symbols @#$%, and numbers 1234
results.details: Test completed successfully.

results.name: test_multiline_long_text
results.tested: Translating multiline text (length 182 chars) to German (dest='de')
results.expected: German translated text longer than 20 chars, not identical to English source
results.returned: 'Googletrans ist eine kostenlose und unbegrenzte Python-Bibli...' (Length: 207)
results.details: Test completed successfully.

results.expected: ValueError raised due to invalid language code
results.returned: Raised exception: ValueError: invalid destination language
results.details: Test completed successfully.
